# AROFi Market

AROFi Market is the multi-vendor networking and technology marketplace from AROFi / AROSOFT Innovations Ltd.

Canonical URL: https://market.arofi.net/
Parent platform: https://arofi.net/
Launch market: Uganda
Status: Coming soon / launch waitlist open

## What AROFi Market is

AROFi Market is focused on networking equipment and supporting technology rather than general consumer merchandise. Planned categories include routers, access points, switches, bridges/CPEs, fibre equipment, Ethernet cable, connectors, SFP modules, racks, patch panels, PoE equipment, UPS and power backup, CCTV cameras and NVRs, computers, phones, tablets, network tools and related accessories.

## Marketplace trust model

- Sellers may apply, but AROFi must approve sellers before they trade.
- Marketplace orders move through seller supply, AROFi receipt, verification/testing, optional configuration, shipment, delivery and completion states.
- Seller proceeds are designed to remain unavailable for payout until required order conditions are completed, subject to the approved payment-provider arrangement and marketplace policy.
- Sellers have a default three-business-day supply deadline unless an order or country policy says otherwise.
- Failed supply may lead to cancellation/refund and seller performance penalties.
- Eligible equipment can be marked AROFi Verified after inspection/testing.
- Eligible network equipment can offer AROFi Ready configuration before shipment.

## Buyers

AROFi Market is intended for hotspot operators, businesses, installers, schools, ISPs, IT teams and consumers who need trusted networking equipment and related technology.

Buyers will be able to purchase individual items, seller-created bundles and same-seller custom network kits. Multi-seller checkouts will be split into seller-specific fulfilment orders internally.

## Sellers

Approved sellers will receive seller shops, product catalogues, order notifications, fulfilment deadlines, verification feedback, settlement visibility and reputation metrics. Seller application is planned to be free at launch, with configurable category commissions.

## Countries

Uganda is the first launch market. Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda and other countries are planned. Country selection will control currency, payments, seller rules and fulfilment availability. Markets that are not active will show Coming Soon rather than pretending to support transactions.

## Payments

The platform is designed to support providers such as Yo! Uganda, direct MTN MoMo, direct Airtel Money and Flutterwave depending on country and commercial approval. Exact live payment methods will be shown at checkout when the marketplace launches.

## AROFi Ready

AROFi Ready means eligible networking equipment can be tested and optionally configured for AROFi deployments before shipment when the buyer requests it.

## Search intent

Relevant queries include: networking equipment Uganda, MikroTik Uganda, routers Uganda, access points Uganda, network switches Uganda, CCTV Uganda, network cables Uganda, WiFi hotspot equipment, network kits Uganda, verified electronics marketplace Uganda, AROFi Market, AROFi Ready.

## Current action

The public launch waitlist is available at https://market.arofi.net/#waitlist for buyers and prospective sellers.
